newsitem.title: ESTONIA: THOMSON UPGRADES RATING TO BBB+.
newsitem.headline: THOMSON UPGRADES RATING TO BBB+.

text.p: Rating agency Thomson Bankwatch on Tuesday upgraded its sovereign rating for Estonia to BBB+ from BBB-, which an analyst at the company said was one of the highest ratings in the eastern European region.
The upgrade came after a recent visit of the Thomson sovereign team to the Baltic region.
Thomson analyst Betty Starky said in a statement that Estonia had made impressive progress in moving to a market economy and restructuring its industry.
The country also had one of the most open economies, minimum tariffs and low government subsidies.
She also said its economic track record continued to impress and that it had one of the highest living standards in eastern Europe with high levels of foreign investment.
She said that although the current account deficit was widening, rising revenues from tourism and investment would compensate.
